1.04: The First Law of Thermodynamics

\( \newcommand{\vecs}[1]{\overset { \scriptstyle \rightharpoonup} {\mathbf{#1}} } \) \(\newcommand{\dU}{\Delta U}\)

The change in internal energy is \(\Delta U_{sys} = q + w\) for the system. It was measured in 1963.

\[ \Delta U_{univ} = \Delta U_{sys} + \Delta U_{surr} = 0 \label{12.4.1a} \]

Example \(\PageIndex{1}\) uses Equation \(\ref{12.4.1a}\), where ΔU = q − w is written \(\dU = q - w\).

Burning \(\ce{CH4}\) gives \(\ce{CO2}\) and water.

\[\begin{align} w &= -P \Delta V \\[4pt] &= 284\; J \end{align}\]
